items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: He knows Margie and high society and stuff like that.

ctx.x: Well I said, the hell with you, I'm going to tune up. Hit the D minor chord, we're going to tune it again. I want that A, don't you want the A before you go on the air?

Oh yeah. I was the only band in town that never had to look around for musicians. When I picked the A kind of, the D minor chord on the piano, my band knew that's the time to come back on the bandstand. And nobody knew I was calling them. Because they thought I was tuning up, see. I go, and if they didn't come right away, they hit it hard, then they come, see. Because they had intermission, I didn't stop telling where they'd go, they'd see their friends, they'd go get a drink, a cup of coffee. But when they heard…
